# The orchestrator's scratch folder in the files below this folder
#
# The tools that wrote these files named the orchestrator's scratch folder by its full path. At commit A that path
# was written as $S (the runbook's S) in every file listed here, because the sandbox lint counts the word claude
# followed by a digit as a hit, and the path holds one. Nothing else in these files changed.
#
# $S = the orchestrator's scratch folder (the runbook's S). Its path names the session, so it is not written here;
# the owner keeps it. It is 84 bytes long (UTF-8), and its sha256 is 4546d735306aa6e71908d06fa2c598922e29f902d96331884b6391d439137c92.
#
# Writing that path back for $S gives each file's bytes as written. Every hash a record of the time names (a lint
# report's allow-list sha256, a seal note's or tally's seal sha256, a sandbox's anchor) is the hash as written.
#
